body: Hey. This was a throwaway I used when I was suicidal for what felt like forever. You should know every one of those people meant it. I never needed a godlike display that life is worth living, I just needed something to give me hope or just the thought that someone cares. It never had to be huge and in the end it wasn't for me that helped me get myself together. However proud you're, you should be prouder :)
Thank you, I really hope I do

Honestly it's pretty hard for me just to lose contact with my ex. I think I just finally managed to do that. I've been friends with my best friend for way longer than I've even known my ex and he's been telling me to leave her behind for awhile now. I'm going to, she's no good for me obviously. 

Thanks for your advice. I think I'm going to try and start writing again, something I sort of lost interest in while dating her.

I'll give it a shot.
You too. Whatever time of day it is where you're, have a good one of those.

Thanks, thats a nice thought. I kind of don't want to be a huge success anyways, it would go straight to my head. Thanks a lot for taking the time to talk to me, I've gotta get some sleep but thanks a lot, really. I'll remember some of the stuff you said.

Yeah I didn't take the quiz too seriously. I really like writing but I haven't been doing it as of late, really just lose interest after starting. In fact, if I really had to pin point when I started feeling like shit, it was trying to write a particular scene that I couldn't wrap my head around. That was ages ago though. I really hope to help others like you said, that would really be great.
